info.title: Calendly
info.description: Calendly is a scheduling automation platform. This connector enables listing events, invitees, availability, creating scheduling links, and canceling events to complement the certified connector's trigger-focused coverage.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile including their URI, organization, and scheduling URL.
Lists scheduled events for the authenticated user with optional filtering by status, date range, and invitee email.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User (resource.uri).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by event status: active or canceled.

parameters.name: min_start_time
parameters.description: Only return events starting at or after this time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: max_start_time
parameters.description: Only return events starting before this time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: invitee_email
parameters.description: Filter events by invitee email address.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for fetching the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: start_time:asc or start_time:desc.

get.description: Returns the full details of a specific scheduled event by its UUID.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event.

get.description: Lists all invitees for a specific scheduled event, including their contact info and custom question responses.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by invitee status: active or canceled.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter by invitee email address.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for fetching the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: created_at:asc or created_at:desc.

post.description: Cancels a scheduled event with an optional cancellation reason sent to all participants.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event to cancel.

reason.description: Cancellation reason sent to all participants.

post.description: Creates a single-use scheduling link for an event type, ideal for personalized outreach.

owner.description: Event type URI to create the link for (from List Event Types).

max_event_count.description: Maximum number of bookings allowed (typically 1 for single-use).

get.description: Returns available time slots for a specific event type within a date range.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Event type URI (from List Event Types).

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the availability window (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the availability window (ISO 8601).

200.description: A list of available time slots.

get.summary: When a New Event Is Scheduled
get.description: Triggers when a new event is scheduled for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: x-user-uri
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User (resource.uri). Used by the policy to build the real request.

200.description: A list of newly scheduled events.

get.description: Lists all event types (meeting templates) for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User (resource.uri).

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter to only active (true) or inactive (false) event types.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for fetching the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: name:asc or name:desc.

get.description: Returns time ranges where the user is busy within a specified window.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User (resource.uri).

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the time range to check (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the time range to check (ISO 8601).

200.description: A list of busy time ranges.

get.description: Returns full details of a specific invitee for a scheduled event.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event.

parameters.name: invitee_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the invitee.

get.description: Returns the user's configured availability schedules including working hours and time-off rules.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User URI from Get Current User (resource.uri).

avatar_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last profile update.

event_memberships.description: Array of host users for this event.

next_page_token.description: Token for next page (null if no more pages).

event_type.description: URI of the associated event type.

rescheduled.description: Whether this invitee was rescheduled from another event.

canceled_by.description: Name of the person who canceled.

booking_url.description: The single-use scheduling URL to share.

owner.description: The event type URI this link belongs to.

collection.description: Array of available time slot objects.

invitees_remaining.description: Number of spots remaining for group events.

scheduling_url.description: Direct booking URL for this time slot.

active.description: Whether this event type is currently active.

pooling_type.description: For round-robin events: round_robin or collective.

secret.description: Whether the event type is hidden from the public page.

collection.description: Array of busy time range objects.

type.description: Type of busy time (e.g., calendly, external).

buffered.description: Whether this includes buffer time around an event.

event.description: Reference to the Calendly event causing the busy time.

rescheduled.description: Whether this was rescheduled from another event.

old_invitee.description: URI of the previous invitee record if rescheduled.

new_invitee.description: URI of the new invitee record if rescheduled.

default.description: Whether this is the user's default schedule.

type.description: Rule type: wday (weekday) or date (specific date).

wday.description: Day of week (e.g., monday, tuesday). Only for wday type.

date.description: Specific date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only for date type.
